scope: Local source qualification — SM4 gateway transport resubmission
revision_note: Both arms used these 14 revisions. Folders c00bad4d differs from the earlier comparison's b9ac1212 only in tests/Hexalith.Folders.Server.Tests/FoldersHumanCommandCatalogTests.cs (an outside fast-forward pull during this session).

arms.baseline: Revisions above plus the retained local changes (Folders EventStoreOperationalStatusReadModel.cs and its test; EventStore SubmitCommandHandler.cs, RouteCatalogAuthority.cs and their tests).
arms.candidate: Baseline plus the EventStore gateway transport registration and its two new test files.

candidate_change.summary: AddEventStoreDomainServiceCore applies the existing AddEventStoreBoundedInvocationResilience policy to the SDK gateway client (IEventStoreGatewayClient): one attempt owns the 30 s budget, early transient replies still retry, the inherited 10 s attempt/retry pipeline is removed for that client only.

original_attempt_ms.FencedActorRpc: started at +10.0 s, still running when the client attempt was cancelled at 10,054 ms

denial_trace.original_outcome: Domain rejection decided 7.6 s after the resubmission started and persisted after the 202 was returned.
denial_trace.state_producing_202: IdempotencyAdmissionState Pending written by the original's ExecutionBegin, read by the duplicate admission as IdempotencyAdmissionDecision.Pending; SubmitCommandHandler returns a plain SubmitCommandResult for Pending, which the gateway controller writes as Accepted.
denial_trace.trigger: Folders Server's IEventStoreGatewayClient inherited the SDK ConfigureHttpClientDefaults standard pipeline: 10 s attempt timeout, 30 s total, POST retries.
denial_trace.baseline_same_path: Yes. Same Polly defaults and Pending branch in both arms; reproduced live in baseline-1. Retained earlier logs show inherited-pipeline attempt timeouts with resubmission in the prior passing baseline (6), the a878668e baseline (5), the paired default baseline (2) and every earlier candidate run (1-3).

first_attempt_ms.AdmissionCompletion: 573 (failed: cancelled by the 10 s client attempt timeout)

binding_trace_breakdown.second_admission: 2,271 ms: the transport resubmission after the cancelled first attempt. Removed by the change.
binding_trace_breakdown.fenced_actor_rpc: 262 ms to actor Processing; 251 ms to domain invocation; /process 3,341 ms, of which seven sequential native source-head reads took 552, 430, 520, 425, 378, 402 and 157 ms (2,864 ms) each after an 8-11 ms workload token; event persistence 140 ms; publish and completion 150 ms.
binding_trace_breakdown.execution_fence: Each ValidateExecutionAsync spends about 15 ms in route-catalog state I/O; the rest is unlogged actor and catalog work under load.

lifecycle_trace_breakdown.per_observation: Folders-side catalog lease 30-85 ms (GET, GET, CAS POST, CAS 409 retry under concurrency), EventStore read handling 550-780 ms, Folders-side release about 15 ms.
lifecycle_trace_breakdown.disposition: No change. The two ACL reads authenticate different streams and the fresh folder-head read after selection detects a source advance; none can be shared or reordered.

live_runs.label: baseline-1
live_runs.disposition: Unknown-provider denial returned 202. The 10 s attempt timed out during the fenced actor call; the resubmission's admission read the original's Pending reservation and returned Accepted after the original had already been rejected and persisted.

live_runs.label: baseline-2
live_runs.disposition: Denial passed. Repository binding was accepted by the original at 10.6 s, just after its 10 s attempt was cancelled; two resubmissions spent 6.7 s in admission and 6.7 s in reconciliation, the 30 s total timeout returned 503, and the fixture's 75 s retry deadline cancelled the call (test line 213).

live_runs.label: baseline-3
live_runs.disposition: Unknown-provider denial returned 503 provider_unavailable after two attempt timeouts and the 30 s total timeout.

live_runs.label: candidate-1
live_runs.disposition: Unknown-provider denial returned 403 from one 14 s attempt with durable completion. Pipeline folder creation (test line 208) then took about 28 s inside EventStore for its single attempt, missed the 30 s budget twice and the fixture's 75 s deadline cancelled it. No resubmission occurred.

live_runs.label: candidate-2
live_runs.disposition: Fixture bootstrap AddUserToTenant through the EventStore gateway returned 500 before the test body (not routed through the changed client).

live_runs.label: candidate-3
live_runs.disposition: Same fixture bootstrap AddUserToTenant 500 as candidate-2.

p95.baseline: none: no fresh baseline run passed
